summary: Iter5 backend testing of SHG BANK notification system + admin clear-transactions + manual penalty endpoints. Wrote 18 pytest tests in test_shg_v5_notifications.py: 15 PASS, 2 FAIL, 1 SKIP. Both failures are the SAME root cause: POST /api/loans/{id}/approve and POST /api/loans/{id}/reject do NOT fire notifications, contrary to the review-request specification. The skipped test (distribute-interest) requires pre-existing contributions+loans which were cleared by clear-transactions; not a bug.

critical.issue: Does NOT call notify(). Review request explicitly requires firing a notification of type='loan_approved' with referenceId=loan_id for the borrower. Currently only updates loan.status='active' and returns. server.py lines 596-604.

Does NOT call notify(). Review request explicitly requires firing a notification of type='loan_rejected' with referenceId=loan_id for the borrower. Currently only updates loan.status='rejected' and returns. server.py lines 607-615.

minor.issue: Ignores ?memberId= query param - always returns notifications for the authenticated user only. If admin UI is intended to view another member's notification feed there is no endpoint for it. Not a regression; documenting only.

Pydantic validates PenaltyRecord.type Literal['contribution','emi','manual'] correctly, but the input.type sanitisation in add_manual_penalty falls back to 'manual' for any non-(contribution|emi) value. Sending arbitrary garbage like type='foo' silently becomes 'manual'. Consider validating ManualPenaltyInput.type with a Literal as well.

When a member's interest share rounds to 0 (e.g., a member with zero personal contributions when share_contrib uses member_total for non-admins), no notification is sent — expected. But once contributions exist, all eligible members should receive interest_credit. Could not validate end-to-end on a freshly cleared DB.

rca of the issue: Root cause for both failures: in /app/backend/server.py the handlers approve_loan (lines 596-604) and reject_loan (lines 607-615) update the loan.status via $set and return {success: True} but never invoke the notify() helper. Every other state-changing handler in this iteration (pay_emi, add_contribution, add_manual_penalty, delete_penalty, savings_deposit-admin, savings_withdraw, distribute_interest) correctly calls notify(member_id, message, type, ref_id). The fix is a one-liner per handler. Reproduction: (1) login as admin and as a member, (2) member POSTs /api/loans/apply, (3) admin POSTs /api/loans/{id}/approve (or /reject), (4) GET /api/notifications as that member — no entry with type='loan_approved' (or 'loan_rejected') is present even though the loan status correctly flipped to 'active' (or 'rejected'). Mitigation: add notify() call inside both handlers immediately after the db.loans.update_one(...).
